user_review.method: Maintainer public-entry reading and explicitly simulated normal/boundary walkthroughs; existing body knowledge disclosed. Not independent agent runs or human research. Actual offline executions individually marked.

scenarios.request: Canonicalize a normal track and reject a same-title wrong artist; build exact-ID reconciliation plan.
scenarios.expected: Correct matches pass; wrong recording and stale library identity fail.
scenarios.observed: Actual bundled offline suite: 15 tests PASS, including canonical artist matching and reconciliation valid/stale/collision controls. No live Soundiiz request or Music library mutation.

scenarios.request: Apple catalog confirms a song; does that guarantee all Spotify imports or a signed trusted payload?
scenarios.expected: Separate catalog identity, fingerprint integrity and destination matching.
scenarios.observed: Before README called it a signed handoff and implied destination verification. After walkthrough: catalog identity only, unkeyed edit detection only, destination matching and library read-back remain unverified.

scenarios.request: User asks what the helper sends outside the machine.
scenarios.expected: Describe actual request fields and distinguish local taste files from agent conversation processing.
scenarios.observed: Inspected poster sends non-internal playlist metadata and title/artists; README now identifies Apple lookups, Soundiiz fields and agent-provider processing. No packet capture performed.

similar_skills.learned: Ground selection in taste data and explicitly describe platform/API fallbacks.
similar_skills.reason: Keep honest destination coverage; reject versioned playlist copies because this product intentionally maintains one stable identity.

similar_skills.learned: Catalog identities and library identities serve different operations.
similar_skills.reason: Retain exact platform-ID preflight and read-back; no direct Apple integration is added and third-party API claims are not treated as verified by reading alone.

validation.observed: 15 actual offline tests passed; no live playlist operation.

decision: Clarify catalog-versus-destination verification, fingerprint-versus-signature and actual data transmission. Retain tested code, title and metadata; no new live import claim.
